info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Interviews-v1-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Interview Listing API enables companies to efficiently manage interview processes for job applicants. It provides comprehensive access to details about scheduled interviews, allowing users to retrieve and review interview information seamlessly. This API is particularly useful for HR teams, recruiters, and hiring managers who need a centralized view of the interview stage in the recruitment workflow. By facilitating the organization and tracking of interviews, this API enhances collaboration and decision-making throughout the hiring process.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of all applications related to interviews. It provides comprehensive details about each interview application, including the applicant's information and application status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve interview applications. It must be formatted as JSON and should adhere to the specified schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested interview applications.

ListCareersApplicationsInterviewsRequest.description: This schema represents a string type payload for the GET request body related to interview operations. It may include relevant details and data as a string.

status.description: Indicates the status of the application retrieval (true/false).

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the application.

resultId.description: Identifier for the specific result of the application.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the request.

audit.description: Audit information for tracking the creation of this application.

ListCareersApplicationsInterviewsRespons.description: Response schema for the GET operation on interview applications.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the application.

createdAt.description: Timestamp representing when the application was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the application was created through an automated process.

Audit.description: Contains audit details for the application including creator and timestamps.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
